description: Initial library-level exposure targets derived by aggregating the existing domain MIX_WEIGHTS. Recalculate after the 450k checkpoint and BPE-4096 migration using actual token counts.
notes: Targets are starting hypotheses, not measured corpus proportions.
The existing domain weights sum to 1.085; the values above are normalized family aggregates, rounded to four decimals.
The sampler renormalizes over libraries actually present in the training split only.
Validation and holdout documents must never be passed to the sampler.
